name: SIUU-2: Unexpected System Integrity Failures in Software
description: The spacecraft's onboard intrusion-detection app (SPACECOP) raised an alert in its telemetry — the satellite itself flagged tampering. Surfaces the on-board detection directly and closes the command→effect loop.
query:
FROM logs.ecs.spacecraft.events
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 hour AND target_name == "SPACECOP" AND packet_name == "SPACECOP_REPORT_TLM"
| GROK message "\\[SPACECOP\\] %{DATA:spacecop.category}: %{GREEDYDATA:spacecop.detail}"
| GROK message "SPARTA ID=%{DATA:spacecop.sparta_id} \\(%{GREEDYDATA:spacecop.description}\\)"
| GROK message "Command Flooding Detected: %{DATA:spacecop.subject} at %{NUMBER:spacecop.rate} cmd/min \\(threshold: %{NUMBER:spacecop.threshold}\\)"
| GROK message "ML Anomaly Detected: %{DATA:spacecop.system} %{DATA:spacecop.data_type} - Feature: %{GREEDYDATA:spacecop.feature}"
| GROK message "Replay Attack Detected: Duplicate packet %{GREEDYDATA:spacecop.replay_packet}"
| GROK message "CTI-based Detected \\(SPARTA-ID %{DATA:spacecop.cti_id}, file \\(%{DATA:spacecop.file} \\(sha256=%{DATA:spacecop.sha256}\\)\\)found"
| EVAL `spacecop.category` = CASE(`spacecop.cti_id` IS NOT NULL, "CTI-based Detected", `spacecop.category`)
| KEEP @timestamp, target_name, packet_name, message, spacecop.category, spacecop.sparta_id, spacecop.description, spacecop.subject, spacecop.rate, spacecop.threshold, spacecop.system, spacecop.data_type, spacecop.feature, spacecop.replay_packet, spacecop.cti_id, spacecop.file, spacecop.sha256, PACKETID_EVENTTYPE
| LIMIT 100
author: Elastic
false_positives: An onboard IDS self-test or a benign anomaly can raise an informational message. Scope to alert-level messages; tune per mission via exceptions.
note:
## SPARTA Investigation Guide

### Detection logic
An ES|QL rule over the events feed that flags every SPACECOP on-board IDS report (SPACECOP_REPORT_TLM) and PARSES the alert message so the alert exposes the SPECIFIC finding the satellite's IDS named — PER EVENT, not a single fixed label. It parses ALL five SPACECOP message formats: IOB-detected (`spacecop.sparta_id` e.g. SMSR-3 + `spacecop.description`), command-flooding (`spacecop.subject`/`spacecop.rate`/`spacecop.threshold`), ML-anomaly (`spacecop.system`/`spacecop.data_type`/`spacecop.feature`), replay-attack (`spacecop.replay_packet`), and CTI hash-match (`spacecop.cti_id`/`spacecop.file`/`spacecop.sha256`), all labeled by `spacecop.category`. The onboard IDS raising a report at all is the SIUU-2 signal; the exact IOB/finding rides in the exposed fields (different reports carry different indicators).

### Framework reference
- **Tactic:** Execution
- **Technique EX-0005:** [Exploit Hardware/Firmware Corruption](https://sparta.aerospace.org/technique/EX-0005/)
- **Indicator of Behavior SIUU-2:** An on-board integrity/intrusion monitor reported an anomalous condition.

### Indicators of Behavior
- **SIUU-2: An on-board integrity/intrusion monitor reported an anomalous condition.**

### How to validate this alert
Read `spacecop.sparta_id` for the specific IOB the onboard IDS flagged and `spacecop.description` for the detail. Correlate the timing with the hazardous-command and flooding rules and the telemetry effects, and ask the AI agent to attribute the triggering command via the portal log. See spartastixkb.
